title: Bit-Physics Capture Manifest
description: Canonical capture-manifest schema (spec § 2.7). schema_version is 1.1.0 at Phase 4.0 (WU-A bumped 1.0.0 → 1.1.0 adding the optional `gradient_fields`; WU-B adds the optional `active_mask` without a further bump). Both additions are ADDITIVE and OPTIONAL (absent from `required`), so 1.0.0 captures validate unchanged — the spec § 2.7 backward-compatibility guarantee. The filename stays `capture-v1.json` (major version unchanged). Bumps governed by spec § 2.12.

schema_version.description: Semantic version of this capture schema.

checksum.description: Raw-file sha256 of the HDF5 payload as written by the producer. INFORMATIONAL only — the canonical determinism contract lives at the spec § 2.5 harness, not at this field. Storage-format metadata (HDF5 object-header timestamps, etc.) may vary across writes at different Unix instants even when the underlying state is identical; consumers MUST NOT use payload.checksum byte-equality as the determinism gate. Use tools/testkit/determinism::run_twice_and_diff (Python) or @bit-physics/common-ts::runTwiceAndDiff (TypeScript) instead.

claimed.description: Per-sim determinism posture per spec § 2.5 + § 2.6. The enum value `bit-exact-same-hw` denotes the content-equivalent contract defined at spec § 2.5: every state array and diagnostic entry in the canonical Capture is exactly element-wise equal across two runs at the same seed on the same hardware (storage-format metadata excluded). The enum value name is preserved for backward compatibility with pre-sub-phase-capture-determinism-contract manifests; the semantics are the content-equivalent contract.

gradient_fields.description: Optional (WU-A, schema 1.1.0). Per-parameter gradient arrays captured during differentiable simulation. Absent in 1.0.0 captures.

active_mask.description: Optional (WU-B, schema 1.1.0 — same bump as gradient_fields, no further version increment). Active-cell mask for sparse-encoded volumetric state. Absent in 1.0.0 captures.
